claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item creates a persistent bright/dim light field that defines the protective aura's footprint. The current surface has no light-production atom, and the existing area attachment grammar cannot honestly represent that the rod itself sheds light.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the rod's head sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: anchored_item_aura_with_removal_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The protective aura is planted at the rod's location, persists for 10 minutes, and ends early when a creature pulls the rod from the ground. Existing magic-item activation can carry a duration, but it cannot anchor the ongoing area to a planted item or express that specific removal action as the early-end trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground ... The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense_locator_for_invisible_creatures_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura grants a narrow perception override: occupants can sense only Invisible creatures, and only when both are in the rod's Bright Light. Existing grant_sense/truesight is materially broader and would overstate the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light
